units.source_text: 平安神宫是为纪念迁都京都一千一百年而于明治二十八年兴建的，因此不消说，时代节是三大节日中最新的一个。

en.t: Heian Shrine was built in the twenty-eighth year of Meiji to commemorate eleven hundred years since the capital was moved to Kyoto, so it goes without saying that the Jidai Festival is the newest of the three great festivals.

units.source_text: 但由于这是庆祝京都建都的节日，所以尽量把千年来都城风俗习惯的变迁在仪仗队中表现出来。

en.t: But because this is a festival celebrating the founding of Kyoto as the capital, the procession tries as much as possible to show the changes in the capital's customs and ways of life over the past thousand years.

units.source_text: 而且为了显示各朝代的不同服饰，还要推出为人们熟悉的各朝代人物。

en.t: And to display the different clothing of each era, it also brings out familiar figures from those various periods.
